label: 1. Before
note: River near 3 ft; storms training overhead.

label: 2. Downpour
note: More than 2.5 in of rain in an hour at Jackson.

label: 3. River explodes
note: Stage passes minor, moderate and major in about an hour. Press play.

label: 4. Photo
note: Record crest approaching; photo report on Main St.

label: 5. Gauge goes dark
note: The gauge stops reporting for hours: SIREN shows data missing, never 'safe'.
